operator.label: attest
operator.description: Records a verified claim about a referent. Adds attestation metadata or evidence.

operator.label: authorize
operator.description: Grants permission, authority, or normative standing to a subject or referent within a defined scope.

operator.label: bind
operator.description: Associates a referent with a context, bearer, scope, or applicability setting.

operator.label: branch
operator.description: Creates a divergent continuation path from a referent, along which later changes may proceed independently of the original path.

operator.label: collapse
operator.description: Reduces structural scale or complexity by collapsing nested, redundant, or expanded structure.

operator.label: copy
operator.description: Produces a faithful duplicate of a referent or of a representation of a referent, identical to its source in content, arrangement, and composition and derived from it.

operator.label: embed
operator.description: Places a referent inside a containing structure, establishing containment.

operator.label: expand
operator.description: Increases structural scale, detail, or complexity by expanding a referent into a more elaborated form.

operator.label: link
operator.description: Establishes an association or relation between referents without implying containment.

operator.label: merge
operator.description: Combines two or more referents or components into a single unified referent.

operator.label: project
operator.description: Derives a representation from a source referent without modifying the source. The representation may be partial or a selected form.

operator.label: reorder
operator.description: Changes the ordering or arrangement of a referent's components without changing which components it has.

operator.label: revert
operator.description: Restores a referent to the state of a prior version along a version chain, moving its position in that chain.

operator.label: shift
operator.description: Moves a referent from one relation, bearer, context, or structural position to another, leaving its other relations in place.

operator.label: split
operator.description: Divides a referent into two or more constituent components, each of which may itself be a referent.

operator.label: unbind
operator.description: Removes, releases, or severs a contextual binding between a referent and its current context, bearer, or scope.

operator.label: version
operator.description: Establishes a temporally ordered version or successor position for a referent and may materialize that version as a new referent or representation.
